incomeAssessment.scope: Targeted tenant energy credits, paid training and fuel/compliance household incidence; original partial clinical estimate retained.
incomeAssessment.rationale: SOMAH supplies real tenant-credit and paid-training mechanisms in Southeast LA, but no current CBE-attributable household/trainee count or actual net payment amount. Existing state funding and historical establishment continue without the marginal gift.
directions: Electricity credits can raise tenant resources, offset by bills, rent changes and access burdens; landlord/public incidence remains separate.
Paid training must be net of alternative earnings, taxes, withdrawn benefits, childcare, travel and time; forty hours is not observed paid participation or a wage rate.
Refinery/fuel policy can change prices, worker hours and private care payments; institutional costs and monetized health are not household disposable income.
Full incurred negative costs survive clinical nulls; positive health overlap limits gains only; no survivor earnings are added.
